name: cavemio-stage-bars
title: Stage bars
description: A funnel you can read at a glance: every stage as a bar against the first, the drop-off between them, and widths that ease when the period changes.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- An ordered list: every stage’s count and share is printed on its row, so nothing is hidden behind hover.
- The period switch is a radio group (arrow keys move).
- A visually hidden table gives each stage’s count, its share of the first stage and of the stage before.
- One hue (--chart-1) stepping lighter down the funnel: it’s one measure shrinking, not different categories.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion the bars are simply their width.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Sales pipeline conversion
useCases.description: Lead, demo, trial and customer, with the drop-off at each step.

useCases.title: Checkout funnels
useCases.description: Where shoppers leave between cart and payment.

useCases.title: Onboarding drop-off

features.title: Every stage against the first
features.description: Each bar is its share of the first stage, with its count and share written on its row.

features.title: The drop-off between stages
features.description: Between rows it says how many carried on to the next stage.

features.title: The headline number
features.description: How many made it all the way is the number at the top.

features.title: Switch the period
features.description: Every bar eases to its new width and every figure rolls when you change from this week to last week.

features.title: Focus a stage
features.description: Point at a stage and the others dim, leaving it and the drop-offs beside it.

features.title: Honest colour, readable by all
features.description: One hue steps lighter down the funnel, because it is one measure shrinking. A hidden table gives each stage’s counts and shares.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each bar grows from the left (820ms, 90ms apart) and every count, share and drop-off rolls up from zero.

states.title: period
states.description: The pill is thrown to the choice (460ms); every bar eases to its new width (820ms) and every figure, including the headline, rolls.

states.title: focus
states.description: Pointing at a stage dims the others to 40%, leaving that stage and the drop-offs either side of it.
